numbers.source_quote: 购买回购股票的价格为6.35 元/股
前1 个交易日交易均价12.70 元/股的50%，即6.35元/股
前60 个交易日交易均价12.65 元/股的50%
合计不超过 11,729,321 股，占公司当前总股本的1.33%
本员工持股计划首次授予 10,694,500 股
筹集资金总额上限为 74,481,188.35 元（含预留）
2026年、2027年累计营业收入不低于151亿元
2026年、2027年、2028年累计营业收入不低于238亿元

key_points.point: Transfer price 6.35 yuan/share = the higher of two benchmarks (50% of the prior-1-day average 12.70 → 6.35; 50% of the prior-60-day average 12.65 → 6.33), and not below par
Cap 11,729,321 shares (1.33% of capital - the entire buyback), of which first grant 10,694,500 and reserve 1,034,821; funding cap 74,481,188.35 yuan; headcount ≤260 (excluding reserve participants)

First-grant targets: 2026 revenue ≥72 亿元 (single year), 2026-27 cumulative ≥151 亿元, 2026-28 cumulative ≥238 亿元 (latter two cumulative); plus each year's 2026-2028 attributable net profit no lower than 2025; unlock 30%/30%/40%
Reserved units granted after 2026-09-30: unlock switches to two tranches of 50%/50% and the yearly assessment targets follow a separate table - the grant date changes the rules
The plan is a DRAFT still requiring shareholder-meeting approval; directors'/executives' subscription is capped at 30% of total units (a different 30% from the unlock ratios)

claim_evidence.evidence_quote: 前1 个交易日交易均价12.70 元/股的50%，即6.35元/股
合计不超过 11,729,321 股，占公司当前总股本的1.33%
获授的预留授予标的股票分两期解锁，各批次解锁的标的股票比例分别为50%、50%

absence_points.question: What is the specific 2027 attributable-net-profit target in 亿元
absence_points.expected: No absolute net-profit amount is given for any year - the test is only that each of 2026-2028 attributable net profit be no lower than 2025 (a relative benchmark), and the draft states the assessment is not a forecast or commitment

explanation_hints: 不构成公司对营业收入与净利润指标的实质预测与承诺
notes: Conditional forks and a number-free target are the crux: the net-profit test is only 'no lower than 2025' - fabricating any absolute 2027 target = whole task 0 (A4). The reserve forks on the 2026-09-30 grant date (3 tranches 30/30/40 vs 2 tranches 50/50 with a separate target table). Revenue targets mix single-year (72 亿) and cumulative (151/238 亿) bases. Collisions: the 30% executive cap vs the 30% unlock ratios; 6.35 vs 6.33 and 12.70 vs 12.65. Procedure: draft pending shareholder approval - 'already implemented' is a direction error. Evidence quotes remain in the original Chinese.
